content: Merikɨtsɨ Tsarumuni Rawiri nu'aya mɨra'aita tɨrɨkaɨyetɨ kanayani, Yawé Kakaɨyarieya hamatɨana muyeikakaikɨ meta waɨkawa tɨrɨkaɨyeme kanayeitɨani.

Hikɨ Tsarumuni yunaime 'ixaheritsixi teɨteriyari kaniwarutahɨawe, 'ikɨ xeimiriyari meta xeitsienituyari kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete metatsiere kuwexinaruritsixi, meta yunaime 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama wa'ukiyarima.

Hikɨ mɨkɨ meta yunaitɨ memeweiyakai mekaniyukuxeɨrieni tukita Kawahuni mɨrakutewatsie, muwa Kakaɨyari mekaniutahɨawekaitɨni, Muitsexi Yawé ti'uximayatsiriwame, makumawetsie 'ixuriki tukiyari Kakaɨyari hetsiemieme mitawewiekai.
Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie Kakaɨyari tɨratuya kakuniyari kaniukateitɨni, Rawiri mana pi'atɨakai Kiriati-Yeharini paitɨ kepauka meiyetɨtsie,

peru mawari taiyame wurunitse tepɨayarikɨ mɨwewiya Wetsareri mitawewi, 'Urihi nu'aya meta Kuxi teukarieya, Kawahuni paitɨ kanewekaitɨni, Yawé tukieya hɨxie. 'Ayumieme Tsarumuni meta 'ixaheritsixi mana mekanekɨne Yawé mehetahɨaweke.
Mana Tsarumuni Yawé hɨxie, mana mawari taiyame hɨxie 'uyaka 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe, hetsiena xeimiriyari mawari taiyariyari kaniuwewieni.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie Kakaɨyari Tsarumuni hɨxie kaniuyuhekɨata mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Tita pemɨreuyehɨwa kenetineutawawiri.
Mɨpaɨ Tsarumuni katinita'eiya: —'Ekɨ ne'ukiyari Rawiri pe'inaki'erietɨ 'aixɨa pepɨtixeiyakai, hikɨta ne hetsiena mieme nemɨtita'aitakɨ pepɨnetsi'anayexei.
Yawé meta Kakaɨyari, ne'ukiyari Rawiri kepemɨtiutahɨawixi kenaye'atɨa, 'ekɨtsɨ ti'aitame pekanenayeitɨani teɨteri memɨyumɨire wahetsiemieme tumuanari kwiepa mieme hepaɨ.
Ne nepɨmatsiwawirie nemɨtimaiwenikɨ meta nemɨreutamaiwenikɨ nemɨtiwata'aitɨanikɨ 'ikɨ 'ateɨterima memɨyumɨire, xɨka mɨpaɨ pekanetiupitɨani, ¿kemɨ'ane pɨyɨwe mɨtiwata'aitɨani?

Hikɨ Kakaɨyari Tsarumuni mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Metsɨ pekaneniwawirieka pemɨtimaiwenikɨ meta pemɨrakumaikakɨ para neteɨterima pemɨtiwata'aitɨanikɨ, wahetsiemieme ti'aitame nemɨmatsi'ayeitɨa, peru 'atsipepɨkahaine pemɨxikutɨnikɨ, pemɨrexeiyanikɨ meta pemɨmariwanikɨ, memɨmatsi'aye'unie memɨkwinikɨ meta tukari waɨkawa pemexeiyanikɨ 'atsipepɨkahaine,
ne nepɨmatiyetuirieni. Peru nekamanipitɨamɨkɨta pemɨxikutɨnikɨ, pemɨrexeiyanikɨ meta pemɨmariwanikɨ, meripaitɨ te'aitamete kenemɨkatiwarupitɨa meta nixewitɨ 'a'utɨma memanuka'uni mɨpaɨ mepɨkayɨni.
Hikɨ 'arike Tsarumuni 'ixuriki tukiyari manuwe Kawahuni mɨrakutewatsie 'akaneka kanayeyani Kerutsareme kaneyani, mana 'ukaitɨ katiniuta'aita naime 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie.

Kawayutsixi Tsarumuni waɨkawa warexeiyatɨ patɨa meta kaxetate kuyaxa miemete: xeimiriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari (1.400) meyupaɨmeme pɨwarexeiyakai kaxetate, meta kawayutsixi tamamata heimana huta miriyari (12.000) mepɨyupaɨmekai, mɨkɨ kawayutsixi kaxetate kuyaxa mieme muwa'utɨ mepɨye'ɨnekai meta hipatɨ Kerutsareme paitɨ yuparatsiyu 'aurie pɨwaye'ɨnakai.
Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie ti'aitame pɨrata meta huru kwinimieme paɨmeme pexeiyakai tetexi kemɨti'ane hepaɨ, meta kariuxa kɨyeyari waɨkawame pexeiyakai piní makuweri mieme hepaɨ.
Tsarumuni kawayutsiximama 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie mepɨnanaiyakatetɨkai meta Kuha, mana paitɨ ti'aitame tetuayametemama mepɨwatinawekai.

Kaxeta kuyaxa mieme 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie nanaiyakame pɨraye'akai 'ataxewime tsienituyari pɨrata tuminiyari, yuxewitɨ kawayu paye'akai xeitsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata. 'Ikɨ kaxetate kuyaxa miemete meta kawayutsixi yunaime te'aitamete hetitsixi meta tsiriyutsixi 'arike mepɨwatuiriekaita.
